_about: Per-template generator settings, keyed by the template's name as in approved-templates.json; a template not listed takes every default. Outside generator/, so editing it needs no re-pinning. Keys: declipArt (default true): false keeps a template's pickups where they land when another object's picture is drawn over them (plan.js, declip.js declipPictures). Coldshadow's Fantasy keeps them: its objects are part of what K accepted (the lead, 2026-10-18). Coldshadow's Fantasy had declipArt false from 2026-10-18 (its pickups on K's accepted seeds did not move) and lost it on 2026-11-07 (the lead: K's 10-18 words cover every map). extraDwellings (a list of { type, subtype, per1000 }): the template's own density of one kind of dwelling, to every 1000 tiles of the map's levels, over its neutral zones (plan.js placeExtraDwellings; Golems Aplenty's Golem Factories at 1.35, counted on the original scenario, 14 on its 10,368 tiles, S199).
